integrity: Finite graph bijection, seven-color upper-bound certificate and seven-orbit witness, exact integer clique enumeration, complete symmetry action, and standalone standard-library verifier replayed. Historical priority is not independently established.
scientific_limitations: Exact only at length five, Watson-Crick strand closure, GC content 2 or 3, strict non-overlap, and aligned Hamming distance at least 2; detection is not correction; not a biochemical performance prediction; no all-length theorem.
title: Complete size spectrum of near-GC-balanced, strand-closed, substitution-detecting DNA five-mer synchronization codes
